$comment: Copy to config/sources.json (gitignored) and fill in your own map ids.
Treat these ids as secrets: anyone holding one can read that map.

sources.label: Road Trip — My Maps
sources.$hint: mapId is the `mid=` query param in your My Maps URL. The map must be shared as 'anyone with the link can view'.

sources.label: CalTopo — Backcountry Routes
sources.$hint: mapId is the short code in https://caltopo.com/m/<mapId>. The map must be shared publicly / via link.

sources.label: OnX - Utah
sources.$hint: A .gpx file, or a folder of them. Each file becomes one layer named after the filename. Export from OnX via Content > select > Export. Also reads Gaia, AllTrails and Strava exports. The imports/ folder is gitignored.
